questions.question: Six people G, H, I, Q, R and S are sitting in a straight line facing the north. No one is seated to the left of R. Only three people are seated between R and G. Only three people are seated to the right of H. Q is seated to the immediate left of H. S is not an immediate neighbor of H. How many people are seated between S and I?
questions.solution:
Given: G, H, I, Q, R and S are sitting in a straight line facing north.

No one is seated to the left of R.

Only three people are seated between R and G.

Only three people are seated to the right of H.

Q is seated to the immediate left of H.

S is not an immediate neighbor of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5470cecf98afeaba61c5340980705fa46503ce3c99fcde15722540cb3cc146d8.png] 

 

So, number of people between S and I = 1

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All potatoes are bananas.

All bananas are apples.

**Conclusions:**

(I) All potatoes are apples.

(II) Some apples are bananas.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

All potatoes are bananas.

All bananas are apples.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28d57194ec09cdf9168e16d5977ad7a13dc36ae955f830cc28e211d7efe71dd2.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All potatoes are apples – Follows (Since all potatoes are bananas and all bananas are apples, all potatoes must be apples).

II. Some apples are bananas – Follows (All bananas are apples, so at least some apples are definitely bananas).

So, both conclusion I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

questions.question: In a row of 52 people facing north, Dimple sits 17th from the left end. If only 15 people sit to the right of Avni, then how many people sit between Dimple and Avni?
questions.solution:
Given:

Total people = 52

Dimple’s position from left = 17th

15 people sit to the right of Avni

Avni’s position from right = 15 + 1 = 16th

Avni’s position from left = (52 − 16) + 1 = 37th

Now, number of people between Dimple and Avni = |37 − 17| − 1

= 20 − 1

= 19

Here, the number of people sitting between Dimple and Avni is **19**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

questions.question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 562 428 653 154 749 (Right)

(Example: 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)

(NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)

What will be the resultant if the second digit of the second highest number is added to the third digit of the second lowest number?
questions.solution:
Given: (Left) 562, 428, 653, 154, 749 (Right)

Now,

We need to identify the second highest and second lowest numbers from the given list, extract the specified digits, and find their sum.

(Left) 562, 428, 653, 154, 749 (Right)

Now, arranging numbers in ascending order: 154 428 562 653 749

Now identifying:

Second lowest number = 428

Second highest number = 653

Second digit of second highest number = 5

Third digit of second lowest number = 8

Now,

Value 1 = 5

Value 2 = 8

Sum = 5 + 8 = 13

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
